items.title: 22.6.1 Phenols mein -OH group ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of the -OH group of phenol (PDF 95-96).

blocks.text: Phenol ka -OH group thora tezaabi hai, is liye phenol acid-base reactions mein hissa leta hai.

items: Bases ke saath: phenol bare non-polar ring ki wajah se paani mein thora ghulta hai, lekin alkaline mehloolon mein react kar ke ghulne wala namak aur paani deta hai: C6H5OH + NaOH -> C6H5O-Na+ + H2O (sodium phenoxide).
Reactive dhaaton ke saath: pighla phenol sodium se tezi se react karta hai, yeh bhi acid-base reaction, ghulne wala namak aur hydrogen bante hain: 2C6H5OH + 2Na -> 2C6H5O-Na+ + H2.

Acyl chlorides ke saath: base ki maujoodgi mein acyl chloride ke saath garam kiya phenol ester deta hai. Base phenol se proton hata kar phenoxide ion banata, jo behtar nucleophile hai aur carbonyl carbon par hamla karta: CH3COCl + C6H5OH -> CH3COOC6H5 (phenyl ethanoate) + HCl.
Diazonium ions ke saath: yeh reaction Chapter 24 (Organic Nitrogen Compounds) mein bayan hai.

blocks.alt: Teen panel: phenol + NaOH se sodium phenoxide + H2O (acid-base); 2 phenol + 2Na se 2 sodium phenoxide + H2 (pighla phenol); ethanoyl chloride + phenol se phenyl ethanoate + HCl, base ke saath. Note: base phenoxide ion banata jo C=O carbon par hamla karta.
blocks.caption: Phenol ke -OH group ke reactions (kitab ke mua'adlon ka asal khulasa).
blocks.long_description: Phenol kamzor tezaab ki tarah rawaiya rakhta hai: yeh apne -OH group ka hydrogen hydroxide ions ya sodium ko de deta hai. Acyl chloride ke saath phenoxide oxygen carbonyl carbon se jurta aur chloride nikal jata hai, jis se ester banta hai.

blocks.title: Ester, ether nahi
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke phenol aur acyl chloride ke reaction se ether banta hai. Product, phenyl ethanoate (CH3COOC6H5), ester hai, jaisa kitab ka apna mua'adla dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Phenol sodium hydroxide ke mehlool mein kyun ghulta hai lekin paani mein thora?
blocks.explanation: Paani mein bara non-polar ring hall pazeeri mehdood karta hai; NaOH tezaabi -OH se react kar ke ionic, ghulne wala namak sodium phenoxide banata hai.

items: Phenol + NaOH -> sodium phenoxide + paani; + Na -> sodium phenoxide + H2.
Phenol + acyl chloride (base ke saath) -> ester (phenyl ethanoate).
